$comment: Drain merge-queue safeguards: drain.waitForRedTeamBeforeEnqueue and drain.dequeueOnSendBack are booleans, both standard true. Inherit platform drain preferences unless deliberately overriding here. Environment overrides WE_DRAIN_WAIT_FOR_RED_TEAM_BEFORE_ENQUEUE and WE_DRAIN_DEQUEUE_ON_SEND_BACK accept true/false, 1/0, on/off. Effective values and sources are logged by both drain and red-team gate. Enqueue waits for the trusted post-accept red-team result comment on the exact live head only after a head-bound speculative or sequential red-team run is recorded as queued, running, or attempted; before the review job writes that status, a persisted accepting review run for the live head that owes a pass holds while the red team is enabled, and labels alone never schedule a pass. A queued or running status is live only while its writer is alive. Card-only net diffs never owe a red team. A confirmed send-back break also withholds enqueue until routed. Send-back removes queue membership, confirms isInMergeQueue=false, and comments with the reason. The red-team gate acts immediately; drain checks all live open rows before candidate filtering and its durable queue follow-ups as a backstop. Pending red-team reads retry after drain.redTeamPendingBackoffSec (standard 300 seconds), or when preread comments show a new comment. Pending state is durable and bound to the live head. After drain.redTeamPendingMaxMin (standard 45 minutes) with an owed pass, return and log a health smell naming the PR. Recheck head-bound run evidence and complete comments at the deadline even during backoff. Past the deadline the PR stays held and never enqueues without a red-team result: redTeam.deadlineAction (standard requeue-then-hold, or hold; env WE_RED_TEAM_DEADLINE_ACTION) re-requests a missing pass once through an available review red-team request hook, then logs the hold and publishes one red-team-deadline-held needs-you note per repo/PR/head. drain.enqueueWhenRedTeamNeverScheduled is retired and ignored; only the operator env override WE_RED_TEAM_DEADLINE_ACTION=merge-without-result with WE_RED_TEAM_DEADLINE_OVERRIDE_BY enqueues without a result, logged on every use. Recorded breaks and recorded or active runs remain held. Both positive numeric settings use the drain cascade, log their sources, and accept WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_PENDING_BACKOFF_SEC / WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_PENDING_MAX_MIN overrides. The live drain supplies a durable head-bound red-team request hook, disabled in dry-run; a due request bypasses pending-read backoff and failed requests respect the request cooldown. drain.redTeamRequestCooldownMin (standard 5 minutes; WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_REQUEST_COOLDOWN_MIN) uses the drain cascade and logs its source. redTeam.drainReadsSavedResult (standard true; WE_RED_TEAM_DRAIN_READS_SAVED_RESULT) also accepts completed saved evidence for the exact repo/PR/live head when no trusted result comment exists; confirmed breaks use the existing gate and admission hold. Standard, platform redTeam, tool redTeam, and environment cascade sources are logged. Corrupt/incomplete saved evidence refuses admission. Applies equally to code, docs, config, and data changes; never changes scheduler obligations. drain.prestageWhileCiRuns (boolean, standard true) and drain.prestageTtlMin (positive minutes, standard 30) resolve standard < platform < tool with sources logged. Approved pending heads carrying ready-to-merge run non-CI gates and cache head-bound dispositions in coordination storage. Green check events try this cache before listing, re-reading the head, labels, body/base, every required-check conclusion, the optional CodeQL gate and live red-team evidence. Expired or changed evidence falls back to the full fast drain. Live red required checks or a failed optional CodeQL gate drop preparation; unattributed non-success events preserve green wakes. Preparation never enqueues before the PR own required checks are green. Coupled candidates, manifest-carrying heads and branches requiring preparation retain full-drain handling.
